description: This file defines the BrentSolver class which implements the Brent algorithm for finding roots of univariate functions within the Apache Commons Math library. It provides multiple constructors for adjustable accuracy settings and contains the core brent method that performs the root-finding via Brent's method, including handling interval bracketing and convergence criteria.

classes.name: BrentSolver
classes.description: A class implementing the Brent root-finding algorithm, capable of finding roots within a specified interval with configurable precision.

methods.name: BrentSolver
methods.description: Constructors for the BrentSolver class, allowing default or specified accuracy parameters.

methods.name: doSolve
methods.description: Executes the root-finding process using Brent's method within the specified bounds and bracketing conditions.

methods.name: brent
methods.description: Performs the core Brent root-finding method with interval adjustments and convergence checks.
